FRCS Standard Interpretation Guideline 2024-15: time of supply — VAT rose from 9% to 15% on 1 August 2023 (2023-24 Budget); 9% had applied since 2016
FRCS public notice: VAT calculation — VAT reduced from 15% to 12.5% effective 1 August 2025 (2025-26 National Budget)

caveats: individualTaxYear is the calendar year, inferred from the country's annual assessment cycle (grade I); not confirmed on the authority's own pages in this pass.
companyYearEndDefault is a 31 December app default for new entities (grade I), not a statutory requirement; companies may choose other year ends under national law.

Fiji's standard rate moved twice inside the window: 9% to 15% on 1 August 2023 and back down to 12.5% on 1 August 2025. The 9% row is a lower bound from the start of the window (9% had applied since 2016).
